Hi Karthik —

Quick confirmation before we start the DocuSign run: can you confirm the signing order you plan to use and who will be the primary signatory for the MSA vs. the Order Form? Procurement needs the signer authority documents for our records (we accept scanned POAs and exec sig blocks).

Also, we prefer to receive a final clean PDF of both executed documents for our legal archive (PDF/A if possible). Can you provide the expected time window for the envelope and the contact for any in-flight questions?

Thanks,

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note. Confirming the plan below so procurement/legal have a single source of truth: 

- Signing order (DocuSign):
  1) Helix - Primary signatory: Olivia Brooks (Exec signatory)
  2) Helix - Counterparty witness (if required): Procurement Representative (TBD)
  3) Redwood Inference - Authorized Signatory: Christopher M. Hayes, VP Finance (will receive last)

- Who signs which document:
  • MSA: Olivia Brooks as Helix signatory; Christopher Hayes as Redwood signatory
  • Order Form: Olivia Brooks (same signer) — both documents are in the same envelope with signature tabs linked

- Proof of authority: Attached is the "Helix-Signer-Authority-Statement.pdf" (scanned exec sig authorization) per your request. We will also include Redwood's signer statement embedded in the envelope.

- Envelope timeline and contact:
  • I will send the DocuSign envelope today (target window: 5pm–7pm PT) after Ben completes a final quick proof.
  • In-flight questions: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai) — available 9am–6pm PT; mobile +1 (415) 555-0198.

- Final deliverables after completion:
  1) Executed clean PDF (signed, flattened, PDF/A) — delivered within 30 minutes of final signature to procurement@helixhealth.com and to your legal counsel.
  2) Audit trail (DocuSign certificate) attached to the executed bundle.
  3) Clean copy uploaded to the HubSpot deal record (link included).

Notes / asks for Helix: please confirm if Helix requires a notarized signature or in-person witnessing for either document; if so we should pause and plan for an alternate path.

I will send the envelope once Ben confirms the final tab placements. Looping Marissa for legal QA in case there are last-minute redline carryovers.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations

Hi all — quick legal check from Helix counsel. Thanks for sharing the authority statement, Karthik. Two small asks before we proceed to signature: 

1) On the MSA signature block, can Redwood add a printed name line under the signature for the Redwood sig to include the signer's title (we need explicit title in the executed copy)?
2) The Order Form references a schedule that was rolled into Appendix A during negotiation. We need the final page numbering to be fixed (appendix page numbers changed after the last redline) so our archive matches the delivered PDF.

If both are addressed in the envelope (simple addition of a printed name/title field and a final proof with stable page numbers), we're cleared to sign from Helix's side. Alternatively, Helix counsel can sign the initial envelope and we can execute a corrected clean copy afterward, but we'd prefer everything fixed pre-signature.

Thanks,
Tom Rivers
Senior Counsel, LawPartners (advising Helix Health)
